faqs.q: Why can’t I apply the dining discount benefit using my Axis Pride Platinum Credit Card?
faqs.a: The dining discount is applicable only once per month and on a minimum order value of Rs. 1,500. If you have used it once in that month or if you do not meet the order value requirement, you may not be eligible for this benefit.

faqs.q: Is there any capping on the reward point earnings on Axis Pride Platinum Credit Card?
faqs.a: No, the reward points earnings are not capped and you can earn unlimited points as per your card spends.

faqs.q: Can I get Axis Pride Platinum Credit Card for free?
faqs.a: Although Axis Pride Platinum comes at zero joining fee, it still charges a renewal fee of Rs. 250 + taxes. However, you can waive off this fee if you spend a min. of Rs. 20,000 in a year.

faqs.q: Is there any additional fee charged on international spends made using Axis Bank Pride Platinum Credit Card?
faqs.a: Axis Bank Pride Platinum Credit Card charges a forex mark-up fee of 3.50% of the transaction value on international spends.
